outcome: gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) in the second pregnancy (s-GDM)
cohort: The study included 2372 women who had two consecutive singleton deliveries after 28 gestational weeks.
finding: An interpregnancy weight change (IPWC) of 3 kg/m2 or higher was significantly associated with an increased risk of gestational diabetes mellitus in the second pregnancy, particularly among women with an interpregnancy interval of less than 36 months, those under 35 years old, individuals without diabetes, or those with normal weight during their first pregnancy.
